content: The believer is not given to cursing, slandering or obscene and foul speech.
If you hear that it (the plague) is in a land, do not go there, and if it breaks out in a land where you are, do not leave, fleeing from it.
The strong man is not the one who can wrestle, but it is the one who can control himself when he is angry.
Shall I not tell you about the people of Paradise? Every weak and oppressed one.

Do not cut off one another, nor desert one another, nor hate one another, nor envy one another. Be you, O worshippers o Allah, brothers. It is not lawful for the Muslim to shun his brother for more than three (days).
He who performed ablution well, his sins would come out from his body, even coming out from under his nails.

One who performs Isha prayer in congregation, is as if he has performed Salat for half of the night. And one who performs the Fajr prayer in congregation, is as if he has performed Salat the whole night.
Charity does not decrease wealth.
Whoever prays the two cool prayers (Asr and Fajr) will go to Paradise.
If a man loves his brother, let him tell him that he loves him.
Shall I not tell about the people of the Hellfire? Every one who is harsh, haughty, disdainful and arrogant.
I have only been sent to perfect good characteristics.
Have taqwa (fear) of Allah wherever you may be, and follow up a bad deed with a good deed which will wipe it out, and behave well towards the people.
He who makes peace between the people by inventing good information or saying good things, is not a liar.

The first matter that the slave will be brought to account for on the Day of Judgment is the prayer. If it is sound, then the rest of his deeds will be sound. And if it is bad, then the rest of his deeds will be bad.
If a woman puts on perfume and passes by people so that they can smell her fragrance, then she is such and such, and he spoke sternly meaning an adulteress.
No one is humble for the sake of Allah, but Allah will raise him in status.
Aisha, verily Allah is kind and He loves kindness and confers upon kindness which he does not confer upon severity and does not confer upon anything else besides it (kindness).
Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwaal, it will be as if he fasted for a lifetime.
If you were to rely upon Allah with the reliance He is due, you would be given provision like the birds: They go out hungry in the morning and come back with full bellies in the evening.
The person who goes about with calumnies will never enter Jannah.
A woman is taken as spouse for four reasons, namely her property, her ancestry, her beauty and her religion (her piety). So, get married to the religious one or else you will be a loser.
Being honorable is wealth and noble character is piety.
Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the falsest of speech.
None of you will have faith till he loves me more than his father, his children, and all mankind.
A true believer does not taunt or curse or abuse or talk indecently.
Whoever protects his brothers honor, Allah protects his face from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection.
I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him one hundred times each day.
Allah will not look, on the Day of Resurrection, at a person who drags his Izar (behind him) out of pride and arrogance.
Whoever guides others to do good will have a reward like that of the person who does the good deed.
Whoever prayed at night in it (the month of Ramadan) out of sincere Faith and hoping for a reward from Allah, then all his previous sins will be forgiven.
While a man was on the way, he found a thorny branch of a tree on the way and removed it. Allah thanked him for that deed and forgave him (his sins).
Part of the perfection of one's Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him.
How bad is the food of a feast to which the rich are invited and from which the poor are excluded.
None of you will have faith till he loves me more than his father, his children and all mankind.
He who believes in Allah and the Last Day must either speak good or remain silent.
Piety is good manner, and sin is that which creates doubt and you do not like people to know of it.
Whoever harms (others), Allah will harm him, and whoever causes hardship (to others) Allah will cause hardship to him.
If you were to rely upon Allah with the reliance He is due, you would be given provision like the birds, They go out hungry in the morning and come back with full bellies in the evening.
A good word is sadaqah. Also a good deed is sadaqah.
Do not argue with your brother, do not joke excessively with him, do not make a promise to him then break it.
The blood, honour and property of a Muslim is inviolable for another Muslim.
Whosoever gives me a guarantee to safeguard what is between his jaws and what is between his legs, I shall guarantee him Jannah.
He who asks Allah for martyrdom, Allah will raise him to the high status of the martyrs, even if he dies on his bed.
The most hated person in the sight of Allah, is the most quarrelsome person.
When Allah wishes good for someone, He bestows upon him the understanding of Deen.
Whoever misses Jumuah three times out of negligence, Allah will place a seal over his heart.
Actions are judged by motives, so each man will have what he intended.
None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself.
The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.
The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.
Charity does not decrease wealth, no one forgives another except that Allah increases his honor, and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah raises his status.
The believer does not insult the honor of others, nor curse, nor commit Fahishah, nor is he foul.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
The parable of the believers in their affection, mercy, and compassion for each other is that of a body. When any limb aches, the whole body reacts with sleeplessness and fever.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother" or he said "for his neighbor, what he loves for himself.
Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to mankind.
A good word is charity.
Smiling in your brother's face is charity.
Facilitate things to people (concerning religious matters), and do not make it hard for them and give them good tidings and do not make them run away (from Islam).
The best among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.
Whoever relieves a believer's distress of the distressful aspects of this world, Allah will rescue him from a difficulty of the difficulties of the Hereafter.
The most complete of the believers in faith, is the one with the best character among them.
The best of you are those who are best to your women.
Give food to the hungry, pay a visit to the sick and release (set free) the one in captivity (by paying his ransom).
Wealth is not in having many possessions, but rather (true) wealth is feeling sufficiency in the soul.
Every good deed is charity.
None amongst you believes (truly) until he loves for his brother" - or he said "for his neighbour" - "that which he loves for himself.
The world is a prison-house for a believer and Paradise for a non-believer.
Richness does not lie in the abundance of (worldly) goods but richness is the richness of the soul (heart, self).
He is not a believer whose stomach is filled while his neighbor goes hungry.
Whoever is not grateful to people, is not grateful to Allah.
Whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.
A believer is a mirror to his brother.
Allah will cover up on the Day of Resurrection the defects (faults) of the one who covers up the faults of the others in this world.
The best charity is that given in Ramadan.
He who shows no mercy to the people, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, does not show mercy to him.
Two words which are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and loved by the Most Merciful: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdi, SubhanAllahi al-azeem.
Whoever establishes prayers during the nights of Ramadan faithfully out of sincere faith and hoping to attain Allah's rewards (not for showing off), all his past sins will be forgiven.
The one who looks after a widow or a poor person is like a Mujahid (warrior) who fights for Allah's Cause, or like him who performs prayers all the night and fasts all the day.
No fatigue, nor disease, nor sorrow, nor sadness, nor hurt, nor distress befalls a Muslim, even if it were the prick he receives from a thorn, but that Allah expiates some of his sins for that.
The signs of a hypocrite are three: when he speaks, he lies; when he is trusted, he betrays; and when he promises, he breaks it.
Angels continue praying for one in his place of prayer as long as his ablution is unbroken.
You will not enter paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another.
The most excellent fast after Ramadan is God's month, al-Muharram, and the most excellent prayer after what is prescribed is prayer during the night.
When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, knowledge from which benefit is taken, or a righteous child praying for him.
Instruct your dying ones to say: La ilaha illa Allah.
Whoever called to guidance receives reward equal to those who follow it without diminishing their reward.
Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him.
Backbiting is mentioning your brother in a way he dislikes. If what you say is true, you have backbitten; if false, you have slandered.
Do not make your homes graveyards. The devil flees from the house where Surah al-Baqarah is read.
He will not enter Paradise whose neighbour is not secure from his wrongful conduct.
The nearest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating himself, so make supplication (in this state).
Whoever takes a path pursuing knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to paradise.
When the iqamah for the obligatory prayer is called, there is no prayer except the obligatory one.
What I have forbidden for you, avoid. What I have ordered you to do, do as much as you can.
Leave what makes you in doubt for what does not make you in doubt.
Indeed among the excellence of a person's Islam is that he leaves what does not concern him.
Do not become angry.
Have Taqwa of Allah wherever you are, and follow an evil deed with a good one to wipe it out, and treat the people with good behavior.
If you do not feel ashamed, then do whatever you like.
Say I affirm my faith in Allah and then remain steadfast to it.
Purity is half of faith.
There should be neither harming nor reciprocating harm.
Whosoever sees an evil, let him change it with his hand; if he is not able, then with his tongue; if not able, then with his heart.
Verily Allah has written down the good deeds and the evil deeds. Whoever intended to perform a good deed but did not do it, Allah writes it down as a complete good deed.
Allah has forgiven for me my nation their mistakes and forgetfulness, and what they are forced to do.
Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.
Seeking knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim.
Nothing is heavier on the scale of deeds than one's good manners.
Among the most beloved to me and nearest to my gathering on the Day of Resurrection are those with the best manners.
A believer reaches with good manners the rank of one who fasts and stands in prayer at night.
I was sent to perfect good character.
Ask Allah for beneficial knowledge and seek refuge with Allah from knowledge that does not benefit.
